paper.title_en: Unitarization and the Nature of Multi-Pomeron Exchange in Nonperturbative QCD
paper.abstract_en: We demonstrate that different unitarization schemes, all satisfying the $S$-matrix unitarity constraint, give rise to distinct probability distributions for the number of exchanged reggeons in high-energy soft hadronic collisions. In particular, we highlight that the $U$-matrix unitarization naturally favors correlated reggeon exchanges in contrast to eikonal-like schemes, suggesting that it may reflect a more fundamental structure underpinning high-energy hadronic interactions.
